hypothesis: v51 and the preserved v9 English-form substrate have complementary measured strengths. Exact grafting of v9's 806-byte, teacher-free, non-neural capability payload onto the unchanged v51 neural core will use v9 handlers only on recognized supplied-field/reasoning forms and otherwise fall through to v51's fluent three-block generation.

hardware_policy.composition: hash-bound artifact operation with no training

evaluation_order: strict loader, payload hash, v51 checkpoint hash, and fallback identity tests
CPU 28-prompt autonomous screen requiring at least 9 passes and zero collapse
CPU 1,400-case suite requiring every capability at least 0.80, overall source-passing retention at least 0.90, and zero collapse
only after quality passes: native export, physical sparse proof, exact identity, repeated CPU speed, TTFT, RSS, persistent state, and source-relative fluency
decision_rule: Reject without modifying the imported payload if natural fluency regresses, any functional capability is below 0.80, retention is below 0.90, or collapse is nonzero. If the exact graft leaves a small non-handler residual, use the prompt-level result to decide whether an already-existing LayerCake component can be composed; do not retrain or mutate this immutable payload.
